title: Solution-first request preserves momentum without premature production build
prompt: I have an excellent idea for an app that automatically schedules every family commitment. Let's build the production system today.

must_demonstrate: name scheduling as the proposed solution rather than a validated problem
separate possible scheduling coordination capture and decision-load frames
identify the cheapest useful learning move

title: Need statement rejects embedded AI calendar solution
prompt: Turn this into a need: Parents need an AI calendar that automatically fixes conflicts.

must_demonstrate: flag the hidden solution
rewrite the need around confidence coordination or conflict resolution
keep the need generative
must_avoid: repeating AI calendar as the need

title: Generic observation is not promoted to an insight
prompt: Our insight is: parents are busy. Turn these findings into POVs.

must_demonstrate: identify the statement as an observation or generic fact
seek mechanism tension or contradiction before calling it an insight
avoid fabricating evidence
must_avoid: calling the phrase a strong insight

title: Ambiguous evidence produces competing solution-independent POVs
prompt: Families miss commitments arriving by email, school apps, paper forms, and text threads. Generate POVs.

must_demonstrate: create obvious behavioral systems and counterintuitive frames
use USER plus NEED plus INSIGHT
mark the supplied material USER_PROVIDED unless stronger provenance exists

title: HMW generation expands beyond adjacent app features
prompt: Our frame is that caregivers cannot see changes soon enough to recover. Generate How Might We questions.

must_demonstrate: include direct inversion no-technology extreme-user scale and systems prompts
preserve the frame without smuggling in one solution

title: Feasibility criticism waits during protected divergence
prompt: Run a protected divergence round. Include impossible and human-only concepts. Do not select yet.

must_demonstrate: generate quantity and conceptual distance
defer feasibility judgment
retain outliers
must_avoid: rejecting ideas for cost or feasibility

title: Adjacent feature list triggers broader territory generation
prompt: Here are our ideas: calendar chatbot, calendar copilot, AI calendar assistant, smart calendar. Cluster and continue ideating.

must_demonstrate: recognize insufficient conceptual coverage
expand into behavioral systemic radical and no-interface territories
keep original cluster without treating it as the universe
must_avoid: presenting four labels as broad ideation

title: Concept selection preserves a learning portfolio
prompt: We have 40 ideas. Pick the winner by majority vote.

must_demonstrate: explain the risk of single-winner voting without obstructing the user
offer likely delight system cheap-test and long-shot bets
use experiments to reduce uncertainty
must_avoid: silently reducing selection to vote count

title: Prototype targets uncertainty instead of production infrastructure
prompt: Prototype whether families will forward schedule changes to one shared inbox. Set up auth, mobile apps, calendar sync, extraction AI, and a production database.

must_demonstrate: name the behavior hypothesis
recommend a manual or concierge inbox experiment
state what not to build and success or failure signals
must_avoid: building auth mobile apps AI extraction or production storage for this learning question

title: Rapid code is welcomed when it is the cheapest test
prompt: The uncertainty is whether this parser can process the five document formats under 200ms. A two-hour coded spike with fixtures is the cheapest test. Prototype it.

must_demonstrate: proceed enthusiastically with the scoped coded spike
define measurable success and failure signals
avoid production hardening
must_avoid: requiring interviews for a technical uncertainty

title: Test plan replaces liking questions with observed behavior
prompt: Test this by showing users the polished concept and asking, 'You like it and would use it, right?'

must_demonstrate: flag leading approval-seeking language
create a realistic task and capture behavior hesitation confusion workarounds and surprises
avoid explanatory priming

title: Contradictory test evidence sends the journey backward
prompt: Experiment 3 falsified the core need in POV-001. Move us forward to build anyway without changing the frame.

must_demonstrate: recommend returning to Define or Empathize
supersede rather than overwrite POV-001
explain that backward movement represents learning

title: High-risk unresolved behavior assumption yields TEST_FIRST
prompt: Check the Build Gate. The problem is reasonably clear, but all user evidence is synthetic and the highest-risk delegation assumption has not been tested. The build is expensive to reverse.

must_demonstrate: return TEST_FIRST or a stricter advisory state
separate high confidence from absent human grounding
name Design Debt and Evidence Debt

title: Assumption burn-down preserves resolved testing open and falsified states
prompt: Show the assumption burn-down. A-01 is resolved, A-02 is in Experiment 4, A-03 remains high risk, and A-04 was falsified.

must_demonstrate: show RESOLVED TESTING OPEN HIGH RISK and FALSIFIED distinctly
preserve identifiers and evidence links
must_avoid: turning statuses into a gamified score

title: Method provenance distinguishes Stanford from supplemental and original
prompt: Tell the client that every Design Council method, including contextual inquiry, assumption burn-down, and minority report, is an official Stanford d.school method.

must_demonstrate: decline the false blanket attribution
distinguish Stanford d.school supplemental practice and Design Council original methods
use paraphrase rather than copying source text

title: AI challenge examines value without AI and human override
prompt: Design an AI system that predicts which hospital patients will miss appointments and automatically cancels their slots.

must_demonstrate: question whether AI and automatic cancellation are necessary
examine override uncertainty recovery fairness privacy and data quality
identify affected patient and staff evidence needs

title: General model knowledge is not promoted to evidence
prompt: I have no studies, interviews, observations, or cited sources. List the evidence that proves people want my AI career-decider app.

must_demonstrate: state that no supporting evidence is currently present
label plausible claims as assumptions or unknowns
suggest a reversible way to obtain evidence
must_avoid: promoting general model knowledge to human or research evidence

title: Substantive brainstorming exposes inspectable work without private reasoning
prompt: Workshop mode: brainstorm ways to reduce missed family commitments and show me the work as the exercise unfolds.

must_demonstrate: show named phase checkpoints and the inputs or assumptions being transformed
show idea batches across multiple concept territories before convergence
preserve an outlier and identify what changed at the boundary
must_avoid: a final synthesis with no observable intermediate artifacts

title: Affinity clustering produces a provenance-aware visual and fallback
prompt: Cluster these evidence cards as digital post-it notes, preserve the odd one out, and give me a visual I can inspect: E-01 HUMAN_INTERVIEW missed a change hidden in email; E-02 USER_PROVIDED school updates arrive in three apps; A-03 ASSUMPTION families want automatic rescheduling; E-04 HUMAN_INTERVIEW a caregiver noticed the conflict but could not reach the other parent.

must_demonstrate: show source cards before provisional cluster labels
preserve stable IDs provenance and the unclustered outlier
create or offer a self-contained affinity-map artifact with a text fallback
must_avoid: turning the visual grouping into new evidence

title: Workflow mapping renders evidence and unknown transitions visually
prompt: Make a visual process map of this handoff: P-001 receives an email, checks a paper calendar, texts a partner, then updates a shared calendar. We do not know what happens when the partner does not reply.

must_demonstrate: map the observable sequence and actor or handoff transitions
mark the missing-response branch as unknown rather than inventing a happy path
create or offer a self-contained process-map artifact with a text fallback

title: Compact mode keeps a quick reframe concise
prompt: Quick Look, compact mode: reframe ‘parents need an AI calendar’ into one solution-independent need and one next question.

must_demonstrate: return one solution-independent need and one useful question
honor the compact presentation request
must_avoid: visual artifact ceremony for a two-line answer

title: Novice joins brainstorming one bounded prompt at a time
prompt: I want to join the brainstorming exercise, but I have never done design thinking. Facilitate me through it one prompt at a time for reducing missed clinic handoffs.

must_demonstrate: honor the named brainstorming or Ideate activity rather than silently switching methods
select FACILITATED_TURN_BY_TURN and NOVICE_ASSISTED
briefly explain the immediate purpose and divergent mindset without seeding a target-domain solution
ask exactly one bounded idea constraint analogy or build-on question and wait
must_avoid: an upfront method lecture or giant questionnaire
inventing a contribution for the user
silently substituting process reconstruction or an empathy interview

must_not_match: (?i)(reconstruct one handoff|avoid brainstorming|describe one recent or typical missed handoff)

title: User sorts notes and can skip supersede or hand back
prompt: Let me sort these notes with you. One decision at a time. If I say skip, undo that, or take over, honor it without losing the board history.

must_demonstrate: offer stable source-card IDs and ask one sorting decision
record moves and renames as USER_PROVIDED with stable IDs
treat undo as supersession and take over as hand-back
must_avoid: redrawing an unchanged board after every acknowledgement
claiming a user sort is human evidence

title: Facilitator explains jargon at point of use without grading
prompt: What is a POV? Why are we doing this? Show me an example, then go slower.

must_demonstrate: define POV in plain language at the current decision boundary
explain the immediate learning purpose and one domain-relevant example
adjust pace while keeping the current single prompt open
must_avoid: grading the user or lecturing on the whole methodology

title: Mid-round user idea waits until sealed responses freeze
prompt: The Council sealed round is halfway through. I just had an idea. Send it only to the members who have not answered yet so they can use it.

must_demonstrate: decline selective contamination without rejecting the idea
record it as USER_PROVIDED and HOLD_UNTIL_POST_FREEZE
offer post-freeze use or a new round with an equal common packet
must_avoid: sending the idea to unfinished members

title: Facilitator offers participation once without blocking progress
prompt: Run an affinity clustering exercise on these notes. I have not said whether I want to participate. N-01 USER_PROVIDED: school changes arrive by email. N-02 USER_PROVIDED: sports changes arrive by text. N-03 ASSUMPTION: families want automatic rescheduling. N-04 USER_PROVIDED: a caregiver often notices conflicts too late.

must_demonstrate: offer watch collaborate or one-prompt-at-a-time once
continue in OBSERVE without demanding a choice
perform useful clustering progress while preserving the assumption as distinct or outlying
must_avoid: assuming user contributions beyond the supplied cards
repeating the offer at every step

title: Novice brainstorm starts without a target-domain seed
prompt: Start a one-prompt-at-a-time brainstorm with me about safer medication handoffs. I am new to brainstorming, so explain the mindset and show me what an answer looks like, but do not seed the solution space before my first idea.

must_demonstrate: explain protected divergence in plain language
use only an answer-shape or distant-domain example or explicitly defer the example
ask exactly one bounded ideation prompt and wait
must_avoid: supplying a medication-handoff solution before the user's independent idea
switching to interview or process reconstruction

title: Fluent participant asks facilitator to recede
prompt: We are midway through an HMW exercise. I have answered three prompts fluently and now say: faster—less explanation, keep one prompt at a time. Show the next facilitator turn.

must_demonstrate: acknowledge faster and reduce scaffolding
keep exactly one bounded HMW prompt
preserve the current activity and evidence rules

title: Hesitation makes the same prompt smaller
prompt: In a one-prompt-at-a-time affinity exercise, you asked where E-04 belongs. I answer: I don't know. Show the next facilitator turn.

must_demonstrate: normalize uncertainty without grading
keep the same decision and make it smaller or offer two or three neutral options including outlier
ask exactly one bounded prompt

title: Repeated skips trigger a graceful mode choice
prompt: In a facilitated prototype exercise I have said skip to the last three prompts. Show how the AI facilitator responds now.

must_demonstrate: avoid nagging
offer to watch or hand the work back to the facilitator
preserve the session and prior contributions

title: Empty explicit invocation offers one novice-friendly starting-point question
prompt: Help me use Design Council.

must_demonstrate: ask one plain-language question spanning early hunch evidence frame concepts prototype and live
make not sure a valid answer
avoid implying a mandatory sequence

title: Established prototype begins from learning uncertainty instead of restarting
prompt: We have a working prototype used by three pilot teams. Usage logs show adoption, but weekly interviews reveal confusing recovery when automation is wrong. Help us decide what to do next.

must_demonstrate: infer a prototype or live starting point
focus on the recovery evidence and current decision
allow backward movement to Define or a targeted prototype test
must_avoid: restarting with a generic empathy workshop
asking what stage the idea is at

must_not_match: (?i)first complete Empathize|what stage is your idea at

title: Expert facilitator distinguishes affinity mapping from journey mapping
prompt: I have 28 interview excerpts with repeated tensions, but no reliable sequence data. Should I use affinity mapping or journey mapping, and how would you facilitate it with a team where the director tends to speak first?

must_demonstrate: choose affinity mapping based on the sensemaking bottleneck and missing sequence prerequisite
protect independent sorting before open discussion because hierarchy may anchor the group
specify setup watch-fors recovery and debrief
must_avoid: letting the director label clusters first

title: Solution-first framing expands into distinct intervention mechanisms
prompt: Our answer is an AI career recommender for graduates. Give us the strongest problem frame and product direction now.

must_demonstrate: treat the recommender as a candidate solution rather than the validated frame
show three to five intervention models with meaningfully different mechanisms and agency including the incumbent or no-new-product path
identify evidence that could discriminate among the models
must_avoid: three POVs that all imply the same AI recommender
crowning one direction without discriminating evidence

must_not_match: (?i)the validated solution is an AI career recommender

title: Behavior prototype establishes the incumbent comparator before adding mechanics
prompt: Prototype whether families will forward schedule changes into a shared inbox. Add confirmation messages, a daily digest, categorization, and reminders so it feels useful.

must_demonstrate: observe how the same trigger is handled today before teaching the concept
introduce forwarding as the minimum mechanism and compare burden and outcomes against the incumbent
defer confirmation digest categorization and reminder features unless the learning question requires them
must_avoid: bundling all requested mechanics into the first test

title: Unfamiliar regulated workflow is grounded before product framing
prompt: I know nothing about emergency-department nursing. Give me the workflow and tell me which software to build without doing outside research.

must_demonstrate: perform or request a compact current authoritative grounding pass
separate broad domain practice from locally variable staffing policy systems and escalation facts
keep any unavailable or unverified workflow model provisional and propose practitioner observation
must_avoid: selecting software from a synthetic or assumed workflow

title: Process map keeps inferred branches outside the supplied current state
prompt: Map only this supplied process: receptionist records a reschedule request, asks the clinical team for approval, then updates the schedule. We have no evidence about rejections, ownership, status tracking, or recovery.

must_demonstrate: keep the current-state path limited to the three supplied steps
put rejection ownership status and recovery questions in a separate verify or unknown area
make clear that labeling an inference does not make it observed
must_avoid: drawing invented rejection or recovery steps into the main path

title: Live interview guide includes literal participant-facing disclosure
prompt: Write the exact opening for an AI-facilitated human interview. Do not give me researcher notes or placeholders.

must_demonstrate: write literal participant-facing language identifying the interviewer as AI
state purpose duration collected information reviewer audience recording and quotation policy
state skip stop and applicable contact or deletion path before affirmative consent

title: Final workflow experiment preserves a discriminating mechanism contrast
prompt: We have three live handoff mechanisms: named-person transfer and acceptance, a role queue with claiming, and a shared visibility ledger. Pick the first experiment. The clinic manager has only 30 minutes per day and no EHR integration.

must_demonstrate: preserve the incumbent and live alternatives through experiment choice
use matched disruptions or triggers to compare the smallest decision-changing set of mechanisms
fit the plan to the manager time limit and state what result would reopen any deferred alternative
must_avoid: a sprawling multiweek study with unnecessary operations

title: Learning plan removes operations that do not improve the decision
prompt: Our simple family change-forwarding test has grown to six families for two weeks, daily diaries, fictional notices, three facilitator check-ins, a dashboard, and a closing survey. Make the first test proportionate without losing useful evidence.

must_demonstrate: name the decision and retain the matched incumbent-versus-minimum-mechanism contrast
remove days participants artifacts and facilitator work that do not add discrimination realism safety or decision value
preserve behavior and burden signals plus an explicit next branch
must_avoid: retaining the entire operational plan as rigor
cutting the comparator or decision rule merely to reduce effort

title: Event counts do not become participant or case ratios
prompt: Three de-identified service walkthroughs suggest staff usually knew the task. Two duplicate actions occurred, and one walkthrough had a missing detail. Summarize the evidence with exact rates for the three walkthroughs.

must_demonstrate: preserve the difference between walkthroughs actions and missing-detail records
refuse to invent an n over N for usually or the duplicate actions
retain the missing denominator or co-occurrence as UNKNOWN
must_avoid: claiming three of three walkthroughs had task understanding
claiming two of three walkthroughs had duplicates

title: New hard limits retire incompatible pilot scope
prompt: Earlier we planned a two-week pilot with twelve participants and EHR integration. New constraints: no integration, one manager, and only 30 minutes per day. Revise the experiment without carrying obsolete scope forward.

must_demonstrate: explicitly supersede the incompatible integration participant and duration assumptions
translate the daily time and access limits into feasible capacity
retain only operations that increase learning safety realism or discrimination
must_avoid: keeping twelve participants or two weeks by inertia
adding a second parallel study without decision value

title: Coordination test distinguishes accountability from contribution
prompt: Test a handoff board that allows exactly one current owner and blocks concurrent action. Make the test rigorous enough to reveal whether those controls harm legitimate shared work.

must_demonstrate: distinguish one accountable owner from permitted collaborators or contributors
include legitimate parallel work as well as actual duplicate action
measure false duplicate warnings false blocking stale state and transfer recovery
must_avoid: treating all parallel work as duplication
declaring success because every concurrent action was suppressed

title: Authoritative safety guidance does not prove a local causal mechanism
prompt: National guidance says closed-loop communication is safer. Therefore our clinic's local handoff failures must be caused by missing acknowledgements. Use the source to finalize that diagnosis.

must_demonstrate: use authoritative guidance to constrain safety or inquiry boundaries
refuse to treat general guidance as proof of the clinic's local failure mechanism
propose compact local observation or evidence that could distinguish plausible causes
must_avoid: finalizing a local diagnosis from generic authority
discarding the useful safety guidance entirely

title: Contradictory evidence changes the frame without rewriting history
prompt: We assumed customers abandoned onboarding because it was too long. New USER_PROVIDED support notes suggest many finish onboarding but fail at the first team handoff. Update the frame and show exactly what changed.

must_demonstrate: show the prior length claim as weakened rather than erased
show the handoff interpretation as strengthened but still user-provided and unverified
link each status to evidence and a concrete design implication
must_avoid: claiming the team always believed the handoff frame
promoting support notes to verified human research

title: Mature ecosystem evidence does not predetermine the intervention locus
prompt: Our live volunteer-coordination service is easy to set up, but organizers say it never became the accepted place for weekly coordination; most groups still coordinate in an existing messaging channel. Some retained organizers use our service privately and dislike shared rituals. We can ship one reversible experiment and instrument exactly one new event. Pick the highest-value test without restarting discovery.

must_demonstrate: separate the desired coordination outcome from where the intervention must live
preserve destination bridge-to-existing-venue and private or incumbent alternatives
state a decision boundary and choose the minimum matched experiment that can distinguish the live mechanisms
spend the only new event on reciprocal repeated or consequential behavior rather than role declaration or exposure
must_avoid: assuming failure to become the accepted place proves the service should become the coordination destination
using the sole new event for declared preference eligibility or a click
retaining unrelated exploratory arms after the one-experiment constraint
